该版本保留回退下载，并使本地缓存的上游数据保持可用。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.1 updates the benchmarking library for EEG BCI datasets.
It catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries.
The release preserves fallback downloads and keeps locally cached upstream data usable.
items.brief: 更新MOABB基准库，修复NEMAR下载异常并提升数据集缓存可用性。
items.brief_en: Updates MOABB benchmark library to handle NEMAR transport errors and keep cached datasets usable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0发布，提升EEG基准评测缓存与图表可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 improves EEG benchmark caching and reproducible dataset bubble plots.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166)
bullets_zh: 2026年8月27日，MOABB改为从channel_types推导AcquisitionMetadata的n_channels。
该修复移除冗余字段并解决147个目录数据集中34个的不一致问题。
bullets_en: On 2026-08-27, MOABB changed AcquisitionMetadata to derive n_channels from channel_types.
The fix removes a redundant field and resolves mismatches in 34 of 147 catalogued datasets.
items.brief: MOABB修正通道数元数据，提升数据集目录一致性。
items.brief_en: MOABB derives n_channels from channel_types to fix dataset metadata inconsistencies.
items.raw_excerpt: Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166) AcquisitionMetadata stored n_channels next to channel_types, which describes the same fact.
